# NovaMart Australia — Account and Privacy Support

## Creating an account

Customers may create a NovaMart account using their name, email address and a secure password.

An account is optional. Customers may also place orders using guest checkout.

# NovaMart Australia — Account and Privacy Support

## Forgotten passwords

Customers who forget their password should select “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.

NovaMart will send a password-reset link to the registered email address. The link expires after 30 minutes.

Customers should check their spam or junk folder if the email does not arrive.

# NovaMart Australia — Account and Privacy Support

## Updating account details

Signed-in customers can update their:

- Name
- Email address
- Phone number
- Saved delivery addresses

For security reasons, customers cannot change the email address connected to an order that has already been placed.

# NovaMart Australia — Account and Privacy Support

## Locked accounts

An account may be temporarily locked after five unsuccessful sign-in attempts.

Customers should wait 15 minutes before trying again or reset their password.

# NovaMart Australia — Account and Privacy Support

## Personal information

NovaMart uses customer information to process orders, provide support, prevent fraud and improve its services.

NovaMart does not sell customers’ personal information.

# NovaMart Australia — Account and Privacy Support

## Requesting account deletion

Customers may request account deletion by contacting NovaMart Support from their registered email address.

NovaMart may retain transaction records when required for legal, tax, fraud-prevention or warranty purposes.

Account deletion requests are normally completed within 30 calendar days.

# NovaMart Australia — Orders and Payments Policy

## Accepted payment methods

NovaMart accepts:

- Visa
- Mastercard
- American Express
- PayPal
- Apple Pay
- Google Pay
- NovaMart gift cards

Payment is charged when the order is confirmed.

# NovaMart Australia — Orders and Payments Policy

## Order confirmation

After placing an order, customers receive a confirmation email containing their order number and purchase details.

Customers should check their spam or junk folder if the email does not arrive within 30 minutes.

# NovaMart Australia — Orders and Payments Policy

## Cancelling an order

Customers may request cancellation before the order has been packed.

Once an order has been packed or shipped, it cannot be cancelled. The customer may return eligible products after delivery under the Returns and Refunds Policy.

Cancellation requests are not guaranteed because orders may be processed quickly.

# NovaMart Australia — Orders and Payments Policy

## Changing an order or delivery address

Products cannot be added to or removed from a confirmed order.

Customers may request a delivery-address change before the order is packed. NovaMart cannot guarantee address changes after processing begins.

# NovaMart Australia — Orders and Payments Policy

## Failed payments

If payment fails, customers should:

- Confirm that their card information is correct
- Check that sufficient funds are available
- Contact their bank
- Try another accepted payment method

NovaMart cannot access the reason a bank declines a transaction.

# NovaMart Australia — Orders and Payments Policy

## Duplicate or pending charges

A pending charge may be a temporary authorisation and usually disappears within 3–5 business days.

Customers who see two completed charges for the same order should contact NovaMart Support with their order number and payment details. Customers should not send their full card number or security code.

# NovaMart Australia — Product Warranty Policy

## Warranty period

Most NovaMart products include a 12-month limited warranty from the delivery date.

Products with a different warranty period will clearly show that information on their product page and receipt.

# NovaMart Australia — Product Warranty Policy

## What the warranty covers

The warranty covers faults caused by defective materials or manufacturing, including:

- Products that stop working during normal use
- Faulty electrical components
- Manufacturing defects
- Missing or defective components included with the product

# NovaMart Australia — Product Warranty Policy

## What the warranty does not cover

The warranty does not cover:

- Accidental damage
- Normal wear and tear
- Water damage unless the product is advertised as waterproof
- Damage caused by misuse or incorrect installation
- Unauthorised repairs or modifications
- Lost or stolen products

# NovaMart Australia — Product Warranty Policy

## Making a warranty claim

Customers should contact NovaMart Support and provide:

- Their order number
- A description of the problem
- Photos or a short video showing the fault
- The product serial number, when applicable

NovaMart may offer a repair, replacement or refund after assessing the claim.

Customers should not return a faulty product before receiving return instructions from NovaMart Support.

# NovaMart Australia — Product Warranty Policy

## Australian Consumer Law

NovaMart warranties are provided in addition to customers’ rights under Australian Consumer Law.

# NovaMart Australia — Returns and Refunds Policy

## Change-of-mind returns

Customers may return an unused product within 30 calendar days of delivery.

The product must:

- Be unused and in its original condition
- Include the original packaging, accessories and manuals
- Include proof of purchase

Change-of-mind returns are not accepted after 30 days.

Customers are responsible for return shipping costs for change-of-mind returns.

# NovaMart Australia — Returns and Refunds Policy

## Damaged or incorrect products

Customers must contact NovaMart Support within 7 calendar days of delivery if a product arrives damaged, defective or incorrect.

NovaMart will provide a prepaid return label. The customer may choose:

- A replacement
- A repair, where appropriate
- A full refund to the original payment method

Customers should provide their order number and clear photos of the product and packaging.

# NovaMart Australia — Returns and Refunds Policy

## Refund processing

NovaMart will inspect returned products after receiving them.

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–7 business days. The customer’s bank may require additional time to display the refund.

# NovaMart Australia — Returns and Refunds Policy

## Non-returnable products

The following products cannot be returned for change of mind:

- Personalised products
- Opened hygiene products
- Digital gift cards
- Clearance products marked as final sale

This policy does not limit customers’ rights under Australian Consumer Law.

# NovaMart Australia — Shipping and Delivery Policy

## Delivery locations

NovaMart delivers to residential and business addresses across Australia. International delivery is not currently available.

# NovaMart Australia — Shipping and Delivery Policy

## Standard delivery

Standard delivery costs $7.95.

Estimated delivery times are:

- Metropolitan areas: 3–5 business days
- Regional areas: 5–8 business days
- Remote areas: 7–12 business days

Standard delivery is free for orders valued at $100 or more.

# NovaMart Australia — Shipping and Delivery Policy

## Express delivery

Express delivery costs $14.95.

Estimated delivery times are:

- Metropolitan areas: 1–2 business days
- Regional and remote areas: 2–5 business days

Express delivery may not be available for oversized products or some remote locations.

# NovaMart Australia — Shipping and Delivery Policy

## Order processing

Orders placed before 2:00 PM AEST on a business day are usually processed on the same day.

Orders placed after 2:00 PM, on weekends or on public holidays are processed on the next business day.

# NovaMart Australia — Shipping and Delivery Policy

## Tracking orders

Customers receive a shipping confirmation email containing a tracking link after the order leaves the warehouse.

Tracking information may take up to 24 hours to become active.

# NovaMart Australia — Shipping and Delivery Policy

## Delayed or missing orders

Customers should contact NovaMart Support if:

- Tracking has not updated for 3 business days
- A standard order has not arrived after its estimated delivery period
- Tracking shows delivered but the parcel cannot be found

Customers should provide their order number when contacting support.
